answers.reason: The elected student representative holds an office and takes part only where regulations provide a seat, which is not the case for the senate.
The budget planning round involves office holders of higher rank, and the elected student representative lacks such a higher office.
The appointment committee is a central and higher-level body where the elected student representative has no provided seat.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs and the elected student representative was elected by students to speak for them, implying a seat.
The study commission deals with degree programmes and teaching of the faculty, where student representatives participate.
The examination board handles specific student examination matters and typically includes student representation.
The internal research funding round is for research grants, and the elected student representative is not involved in this capacity.
The module revision working group concerns degree programmes where student representatives take part.
Laboratory equipment procurement is an administrative or research-related task without student representative seats.
Orientation week planning directly concerns students and involves student representatives.
